newsitem.title: USA: New Jersey church arson added to federal list.
newsitem.headline: New Jersey church arson added to federal list.

text.p: Federal agents and local authorities are investigating a fire that destroyed a historically black church in this college town, the Camden Courier-Post reported on Saturday.

A fire that ravaged the First Baptist Church Friday was added to the list maintained by the church arson task force of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms. The federal agency has investigated more than 330 church arsons or bombings since January 1995.
Local authorities said there was no evidence of a racial motive in the Glassboro fire, but that it was arson.
"It's too early to say where this investigation is going," said Gloucester County prosecutor Andrew Yurick.

Flames, seen late Friday evening in the 80-year-old church, gutted the sanctuary by the time fire fighters were able to control them. Investigators told the Philadelphia Inquirer that the fire originated in more than one spot, indicating it was deliberately set.
